Akamai Netstorage and ikeadt.com as PR environment

Look a how HSD and Kvadrat uses Akamai to deploy every PR. Demonstration and presentation of solutions.

Kvardrat pirmary driver is bad performance for large files when using Azure Function backed by Azure storage.
HSD primary driver no iFrame but using ESI include scripts instead.
Previously the test process was not efficient since some functionality could not be tested in Azure PR environments. Solved by test on ikeadt.com for PRs.
Since HSD do not use other services in Azure there is no driver for using Azure as dev environment.
Link to www.cet.ikeadt.com in PR.
Use latest path for ESI to kick in.
Include Header and footer for INKGA website

ESI template file used for testing integration to http://ikea.com developed in collaboration with INKGA and script fetch html from http://www.ikea.com so that context is kept up to date.

Suggestion by is to make Make ESI template script a part of Kompis package. This will enable running scripts locally as well as in GitHub Workflow. Possible a GitHub Action later on.
Script is used to calculate next version from tags instead of change log to be not have to check in changelog file and fully protect main branch.
